description: Flask of Natural Precision Item Level 60 Requires Level 55 Use: Increases your Stamina by 60. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 5% reduced chance to be dodged or parried. Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown) Max Stack: 20 Sell Price: 50
